using MPI
using CUDA
using JSON3

MPI.Init()
comm   = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank   = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
nranks = MPI.Comm_size(comm)
local_comm = MPI.Comm_split_type(comm, MPI.COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0)
local_rank = MPI.Comm_rank(local_comm)
CUDA.device!(local_rank % CUDA.ndevices())

r = Dict{String,Any}("rank" => rank, "hostname" => gethostname(), "nranks" => nranks)

# known good: exactly what the passing health check does
try
    buf = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank + 1), 4)
    MPI.Allreduce!(buf, +, comm)
    r["cuarr"] = Array(buf)
catch e
    r["cuarr"] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 200)
end

# the one addition: the scalar value form the generated allreduce! uses
try
    r["scalar"] = MPI.Allreduce(rank + 1, +, comm)
catch e
    r["scalar"] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 200)
end

if rank == 0
    all = Any[r]
    for s in 1:(nranks - 1)
        push!(all, MPI.recv(comm; source = s, tag = 3))
    end
    println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => all)))
else
    MPI.send(r, comm; dest = 0, tag = 3)
end

# Leave without running the atexit hook that calls MPI.Finalize. The
# result is already printed; the question is whether the collectives
# themselves worked, and a Finalize abort would discard the answer.
flush(stdout); flush(stderr)
MPI.Barrier(comm)
ccall(:_exit, Cvoid, (Cint,), 0)
